instrument_correction.fault: line 193: `const rMid = ob ? (ob.baseMin + ob.baseMax)/2 + 0.36*(ob.outer-ob.inner)/2 : 38.9`. `ob` is OUR OWN parsed glyph geometry. Both our art AND the reference photograph are sampled at rMid, so when our drawing changes the radius moves and THE REFERENCE'S OWN SCORE CHANGES WITH IT. The literal 38.9 is only the fallback that fires when we draw no glyphs.
instrument_correction.why_it_survived_two_rounds: round 1's reverse drew ZERO glyphs at 84px, so it fell through to the 38.9 fallback and looked as though the frozen locus was being honoured. The obverse, which did draw glyphs, was silently measured at r 37.5 and 36.0.

THREE RADII IN ONE `locus` FIELD, one per tier of our own drawing. Spec 6.1 says a locus is frozen WITH THE TARGET. The judge wrote that field itself, in the same session it wrote the rule.
